EffectiveFallbackCandidates.Text: ECC is to enable/disable the golay error correcting code. It defaults to off. If you enable it then you packets take twice as many bytes to send, so you lose half your air bandwidth, but it can correct up to 3 bit errors per 12 bits of data. Use this for long range, usually in combination with a lower air data rate. The golay decode takes 20 microsecond per transmitted byte (40 microseconds per user data byte) which means you will also be a bit CPU constrained at the highest air data rates. So you usually use golay at 128kbps or less.
